\caption{Controlled variants of the E + R + A design; the MES row is the validation-selected MES run of Table~\ref{tab:sota}. E marks the masked entry pairs, R the retention pairs, A the anchor term, and $\mu$ the weight of a top-$K$ loss added to BPR, all on MSCA. Each cell reports the mean test Recall@20 over seeds 1--5, one run per seed, with the best mean of each column in bold. Row E applies MES with the fixed $\lambda$ and $K$ of the E + R + A design and reuses those runs, thus it is not interchangeable with the MES row. Two-sided paired $t$-tests over seeds 1--5, Holm-corrected over the four datasets of each contrast, give $^{\dagger}$/$^{\ddagger}$ for a row significantly below/above E + R + A, $^{\P}$ for A + masked DNS significantly above A + masked BPR, and $^{\ast}$/$^{\circ}$ for a row significantly below/above E. Supplementary Section~\ref{supp:ctrl} defines the variants.}
